detail: Unique UTC+UUID run directory created; TASK_PROMPT.md was the first filesystem artifact and was not overwritten.
Initial git status recorded: logs/graph four existing dirty files and uncommitted T4 v1 run were pre-existing; only the new T5 run directory is executor-owned.
Card inputs and T4/T4R/T3/T2 identities bound with canonical git_blob_id for tracked files; TASK_PROMPT.md bound with file SHA-256.
Interfaces explicitly prohibit reading T4 baseline summary.combination_results and summary.failure_family_profiles; only baseline.cases[] is authoritative.

Five manual implementation repairs were performed with no automatic retry: stdin bytes/text mismatch; duplicate registry top-level scope; non-executable T4 adapter targets required a registry-fixed bash interpreter; max tick age 60 exceeded fixture age and was changed to 0/unlimited; derive negative control required expected target exit code 1. Partial failed evidence is retained under scratch/.
G1, canonical hash recomputation, manifest verification and final write-boundary verification remain the final acceptance gates.

First package self-check had 16/17 checks OK and failed only because the checker counted overall_pass_field_forbidden as a delivery class. Checker now selects exactly qualification/audit/execution/scientific and separately asserts the metadata prohibition. Prior manifest retained as artifacts_manifest_attempt1.json; final manifest is rebuilt and rechecked.
